# Product Card

`commerce/product-card` &middot; content-level &middot; category: commerce

## Purpose

One product: image, badge, name, description, price with sale price and discount, and a button. Five visual variants.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `product` | product |  |

## Optional fields

None.

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Left-aligned, everything shown, solid small button.
- **minimal**: Just the image, name and price. No badge, description or button. Sets `showBadge: false`, `showDescription: false`, `showButton: false`.
- **luxury**: Centered, uppercase spaced name, no description, outlined button. Sets `align: center`, `showDescription: false`, `nameTransform: uppercase`, `nameTracking: 2px`, `buttonVariant: outline`, `badgeVariant: outline`, `imageRadius: @radius.none`.
- **editorial**: Large name and the description, no button: it reads like a magazine caption. Sets `nameLevel: h3`, `showButton: false`, `showBadge: false`.
- **playful**: Centered with rounded image, pill badge and pill button. Sets `align: center`, `badgeVariant: pill`, `imageRadius: @radius.large`, `buttonRadius: @radius.pill`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mobileAlignment` | one of `inherit`, `left`, `center`, `right` | `"inherit"` |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `align` | alignment | `"left"` |
| `showBadge` | boolean | `true` |
| `showDescription` | boolean | `true` |
| `showPrice` | boolean | `true` |
| `showButton` | boolean | `true` |
| `nameLevel` | one of `h4`, `h3`, `h2`, `bodyLarge`, `eyebrow` | `"h4"` |
| `nameTransform` | one of `auto`, `none`, `uppercase`, `capitalize` | `"auto"` |
| `nameTracking` | text | `"auto"` |
| `imageRadius` | length | `"@theme.image.radius"` |
| `imagePadding` | spacing | `"0 0 @spacing.sm 0"` |
| `badgeVariant` | one of `default`, `pill`, `outline`, `tag`, `success`, `urgent` | `"default"` |
| `buttonVariant` | one of `default`, `outline`, `subtle` | `"default"` |
| `buttonRadius` | length | `"@theme.button.radius"` |
| `gap` | length | `"@spacing.sm"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `mobileAlignment`: `inherit`, `left`, `center`, `right`. Overrides text alignment below 480px (`inherit` keeps the desktop alignment). Best effort, images depend on the client.
- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Tables and text honored. Rounded corners and pill buttons render square. | Fine. Product image is a real img with alt text. | Text swaps via dm-text where honored. Images are not recolored. |



## Example usage

This is a content-level component: it goes inside a column, so put it in the `content` of a `layout/section` (or another layout).

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('commerce/product-card', {
  "product": {
    "image": {
      "src": "https://placehold.co/400x400/png?text=Linen%20Shirt",
      "alt": "The Coastal linen shirt in sand, laid flat"
    },
    "badge": "Best seller",
    "name": "The Coastal Linen Shirt",
    "description": "Relaxed and breathable, cut from European flax.",
    "price": "$120.00",
    "salePrice": "$96.00",
    "discount": "Save 20%",
    "url": "https://example.com/products/coastal-linen-shirt",
    "cta": {
      "label": "Shop now",
      "href": "https://example.com/products/coastal-linen-shirt"
    }
  }
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "commerce/product-card",
  "data": {
    "product": {
      "image": {
        "src": "https://placehold.co/400x400/png?text=Linen%20Shirt",
        "alt": "The Coastal linen shirt in sand, laid flat"
      },
      "badge": "Best seller",
      "name": "The Coastal Linen Shirt",
      "description": "Relaxed and breathable, cut from European flax.",
      "price": "$120.00",
      "salePrice": "$96.00",
      "discount": "Save 20%",
      "url": "https://example.com/products/coastal-linen-shirt",
      "cta": {
        "label": "Shop now",
        "href": "https://example.com/products/coastal-linen-shirt"
      }
    }
  }
}
```
